verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, mechanics, and taxonomy. Preserve unsupported stamina, probability, and finish fields as null.
research_scope: Super Dragon Fist — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Revalidated against current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Xenoverse 2 acquisition/player evidence. Historical Xenoverse 1 PQ material was excluded from the Xenoverse 2 acquisition conclusion.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Super Dragon Fist was found. Dragon Fist is a separate Strike Ultimate and is not treated as a duplicate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Super Dragon Fist as a Strike Super with 100 Ki cost.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists the Skill Shop as the Future Warrior acquisition route; independent Xenoverse 2 discussion confirms it is available in the store early in progression.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented Xenoverse 2 acquisition route is the Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because reviewed sources do not establish a reliable canonical stamina value.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist
records.character_source: Goku / Goku (Super Saiyan God) / Goku (GT) customizable partner / Goku (Super Saiyan 4) / Gohan (Adult) customizable partner / Vegito / Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partner / Goku Black customizable partner / Rosé Goku Black customizable partner / SSGSS Vegito customizable partner / Majuub
records.skill_description: A fast rushdown Strike Super that flies toward the opponent and, on contact, follows with a three-hit punching sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation describes a short-distance approach followed, on contact, by a rapid three-punch rush. The move is characterized as multi-hitting/rushdown; reviewed evidence also describes it as fast to activate. Exact frame data and stable universal damage values are not promoted.
records.acquisition_notes: The Xenoverse 2 Future Warrior acquisition route is the Skill Shop. Independent Xenoverse 2 evidence corroborates early Skill Shop availability. Historical Xenoverse 1 PQ42 acquisition is explicitly excluded.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Current documentation characterizes the move as fast, short-range rushdown with a three-hit follow-up. Exact matchup, frame, hitbox, and version-specific performance claims remain outside the canonical evidence boundary.
